new_defect.title: [2.4.2 A] Every page has the same title ("Swag Labs")
new_defect.description:
Environment: saucedemo.com (test). Role: standard_user.
Steps: open login, Products, cart and Checkout: Your Information; read each page's title.
Expected: each page with a title that identifies its content (WCAG 2.1, criterion 2.4.2, level A; Understanding 2.4.2, technique G88).
Observed: the 4 pages have the title "Swag Labs"; a screen reader user cannot tell the pages apart by their title.
Evidence: runs/a11y_20260924_01.json (title field of each page).
